sentences: On a quiet night in December 2010, a young woman disappeared without a trace.
Her name was Lauren Spierer.
The 20-year-old Indiana University student was last seen in the early hours of June 3, 2011, after a night out with friends.
Surveillance cameras captured her walking through the streets of Bloomington.
But then, something terrifying happened.
Lauren was never seen again.
Police questioned friends, searched nearby properties, and investigated thousands of tips.
Her phone, clothing, and personal belongings became important pieces of the investigation.
But despite years of searching, no one has ever been charged in connection with her disappearance.
More than a decade later, one question remains: What happened to Lauren Spierer?
And how can someone disappear into the night… without leaving a single answer?
On April 11, 1970, NASA launched Apollo 13 into space.
Three astronauts were heading toward the Moon, expecting to make history.
But two days into the mission, everything went terribly wrong.
An oxygen tank exploded inside the spacecraft.
Suddenly, the astronauts heard a terrifying message: “Houston, we’ve had a problem.” Their oxygen supply was disappearing.
Their electricity was failing, and the Moon landing was officially cancelled.
Now, NASA faced a much bigger challenge.
Getting three astronauts home alive.
The crew had to shut down their damaged spacecraft and use the tiny lunar module as a lifeboat.
For days, millions of people watched anxiously as NASA engineers worked desperately to find a solution.
On April 17, 1970, against incredible odds, Apollo 13 safely returned to Earth.
They never landed on the Moon.
But they achieved something just as extraordinary.
They survived one of the most dangerous missions in space history.
